built_with: cargo build --profile ci -p solidcraft (and -p solidcraft-cli) at the head above

how_the_question_was_produced.mechanism: a real ACP agent process: it speaks the Agent Client Protocol over stdin/stdout and answers the app's prompt with its own question (elicitation/create), so the card is produced by the protocol path the change adds, not by a mock of the panel
how_the_question_was_produced.agent: a stand-in ACP agent: initialize, session/new, then elicitation/create on the prompt (the exchange is in agent-protocol-form.log and agent-protocol-link.log)
how_the_question_was_produced.how_the_app_was_driven: the app's own control channel (docs/control-protocol.md): ui.agent_chat {add_agent, agent, connect, open, send}, ui.resize {1280, 720} and ui.screenshot
how_the_question_was_produced.window: 1280x720 (the app's own ui.screenshot of the whole window) and 960x600 (the smallest window the app allows)

pictures.what_it_shows: The question card in the Assistant panel: the agent's own question, a button per choice (conservative, balanced, aggressive), and Decline and Cancel next to them.
